note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is recorded as unknown, so that section is not included; synonymy lists, figure numbers, locality and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, sides weakly convex, fontanelle at about one fifth of the dorsal length of the head from the anterior end; mandibles strongly asymmetrical, the left mandible strongly twisted at midlength and blunt apically, the right mandible blade-like; total length about 5.0–6.0 mm. Worker head capsule subcircular, antennae 14-segmented, anterior margin of the pronotum strongly convex. Alate unknown.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown, darker anteriorly, antennae and labrum yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown to almost black; head sparsely setose, body more densely so; total length about 5.0–6.0. Head capsule subrectangular, sides weakly convex (length to mandibular base 2.05–2.20, width 1.19–1.27, ratio of width to length 0.56–0.58); frons inclined forward in profile, shallowly concave at midlength; coronal suture present, not reaching the fontanelle. Fontanelle minute, circular, at about one fifth of the dorsal length of the head from the anterior end. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 4 smallest. Labrum asymmetrical, subquadrate, anterior margin straight, anterolateral angles produced into small points. Mandibles strongly asymmetrical, slightly longer than half the head capsule (left 1.32–1.37, right 1.30–1.35, ratio of left mandible length to head length about 0.63); left mandible strongly twisted at midlength, blunt apically; right mandible blade-like, pointed apically, weakly curved outward at the tip. Postmentum long, clavate, widest in the anterior third, narrowest in the posterior third. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin convex with one distinct concavity, posterior margin convex without concavity.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule, antennae and labrum pale yellow, body milk-white; head and body rather densely setose. Head capsule subcircular (length to mandibular base 0.70–0.75, width 0.90–1.00). Frontal plate oval, appearing as a white spot. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 4 smallest. Postclypeus arched, setose, slightly less than half as long as wide. Labrum dome-shaped, setose. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin strongly convex (length 0.20–0.25, width 0.55).
